text: Veltrixamine-X is a synthetic compound with molecular formula C24H27N3O5. It was first characterised at the Mount Auburn Facility in Ankaris. Pure Veltrixamine-X forms cloudy white platy crystals. The compound is photosensitive under standard conditions, and its literature-reported synthesis yield is 61%.
